releaseNotes:
- Seerr Media Requests Integration: Added full movie and TV series discovery & requesting via Overseerr / Jellyseerr / Seerr (toggleable in Settings, with Your Recent Requests, Trending, Upcoming Movies, Upcoming TV Series, multi-server switcher, and 4K request support).
- Embedded YouTube Trailers: Added fullscreen in-app trailer playback via android-youtube-player with TMDB + KinoCheck lookup, local key caching, landscape-first filtering (skipping YouTube Shorts), and automatic Android TV app fallback.
- Mobile & TV UI Refinements: Fixed 3-column portrait / 6-column landscape search grids with true 2:3 poster ratios, expanded TV season lists and full movie descriptions in request modals, symmetrical 2-column portrait buttons, and row-to-row cursor focus memory.
- Settings & Cold-Start Reliability: Media Requests now guards against missing Seerr URLs with a quick-configure prompt (skipping server picker for single-server setups) and reliably persists across cold restarts.
- App Version Bump: v1.11.0 (versionCode 59)
